'''February 2000 Lakewood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lakewood Mall Barnes & Noble, Lakewood, Washington on 19 February 2000. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d263">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-19-tacoma-washington-2-19-00d263/ tacoma-washington-2-19-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 19 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-19-tacoma-washington-2-19-00d263/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Lakewood Mall Barnes & Noble, Lakewood, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
